parent_objective: design guarded PPO readiness from the combined active-set public-gate base
blocked_by: new public-gate base has been promoted but PPO readiness protocol is not yet specified
invalidates: running PPO directly from the new public-gate base without readiness gates

public_gates: M1043 must design only; no PPO run
M1043 must preserve P0 actor input contract
M1043 must require exact M997, M297/M270, and combined active-set checks
M1043 must require six public replay surfaces before any future promotion
M1043 must define rollback conditions for row15 and row16 regressions
M1043 must keep private holdout blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim PPO readiness without exact and replay rollback criteria

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_ppo: guarded PPO readiness from combined active-set public-gate base
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the first post-promotion PPO readiness protocol without running PPO
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training, no PPO proposal, no promotion
stop_condition: stop if exact post-PPO repair/projection requirements cannot be specified
stop if row15 or row16 rollback criteria are ambiguous
stop if the design would use private holdout for repair
fallback_plan: if PPO readiness is underspecified, route to exact projection gate design
if public overfit risk dominates, route to fresh proof-surface refresh
if design is clear, admit one smoke-scale PPO proposal milestone

hypothesis: A guarded PPO readiness protocol can be specified for the new public-gate base using exact full-corpus gates, combined active-set retention, replay rollback, and behavior/generalization non-regression before any PPO run.
success_criteria: base checkpoint is fixed to the M1041 public-gate base
exact gates and replay gates are ordered
row15 and row16 rollback criteria are explicit
future smoke PPO command and stop conditions are specified
decision_rule: M1043 must admit or reject exactly one smoke-scale guarded PPO proposal milestone; no PPO is run in M1043.
